messages:
incident-bot: URGENT: Elevated latency + errors observed for /v1/generate on canary slice 'slice-optimizer-v2' in us-west1. Severity P2. Creating incident channel.
deploy-bot: Deployed release 'slice-optimizer-v2' to canary (5% traffic) at 2026-03-17T10:13:00Z.
morgan: seeing p50/p95/p99 jump in canary. p99 ~1200ms, p50 ~200ms. Kernel selection falling back repeatedly.
kevin: confirmation from host logs: kernel_select switching to fallback scalar_kernel under batching pressure. KV cache miss rate high.
sara: paging remy (oncall) — remy are you available?
remy: oncall here. joining. what do we have for error types + extent?
kevin: quick log tail:
```
[10:14:23] kernel_select: selected optimized_x86_avx2
[10:14:23] kernel_select: fallback -> scalar_kernel (err: incompatible_align)
[10:14:24] batcher: queue_size=48 target=16
[10:14:25] telemetry: kv_cache_miss_rate=0.72
```
morgan: throughput of the canary decreased ~40%. We also see intermittent 502s when fallback + batchsize>32.
sara: can QA reproduce on staging with same flags?
qa-dave: reproduced locally on staging. When seq_len>1024 and microbatching enabled, kernel selector triggers fallback and latency spikes.
patrick-se: recommendation: flip feature flag kill-switch for slice-optimizer-v2 to stop further rollout.
remy: agreed. activating kill-switch now.
deploy-bot: Feature flag 'slice-optimizer-v2' toggled OFF for canary at 2026-03-17T10:22:00Z by remy.
morgan: traffic shift halted. p99 dropping from 1200ms -> ~300ms but still above baseline.
kevin: initiating controlled rollback of canary pods to previous build. rolling nodes now.
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated at 2026-03-17T10:25:00Z.
sara: any known customer impact? which customers hit the canary?
morgan: two enterprise trials in us-west1 were routed to canary for a subset of traffic. Estimate ~3% of their calls in last 30m saw elevated latency.
patrick-se: CS notified; will prepare a concise customer note after we stabilise.
ops-bot: Created incident page https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-0317-001 and alerted SRE rotation.
remy: monitoring. p50 back to normal at 10:31Z, p99 trending down toward baseline.
qa-dave: post-rollback logs show kernel_select stable again:
```
[10:30:05] kernel_select: selected optimized_x86_avx2
[10:30:05] kernel_select: no_fallback
```
kevin: mitigation summary: feature-flag kill-switch + rollback. Freeze further rollout. Need postmortem and regression tests around kernel alignment constraints.
morgan: action items: add unit test for alignment constraints, expand canary validation to include high-seq + multi-tenant microbatch scenario, add alert for sudden KV cache miss increase.
sara: oncall handoff in 30m — remy please include current status in handoff message.
remy: will do. status for handoff: mitigation applied, rollback complete, monitoring healthy, customer impact low. Downgrading to P2 -> monitoring.
patrick-se: prepping customer-facing text: 'We briefly observed elevated latency on a canary release. We rolled back the change and are monitoring. Minimal customer impact.'
kevin: filed INFRA-762 to track kernel selector root cause and test coverage gaps.
morgan: thanks everyone. leaving the channel open for 1hr to watch metrics. reopen if regressions appear. :thumbsup:
